config.title: letter-spacing and word-spacing

intro.title: letter-spacing and word-spacing
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple text styling project to learn how to control the spacing between letters and words in CSS. You will explore the core concepts of typography and text layout using the `letter-spacing` and `word-spacing` properties. The main technologies involved are CSS properties and values, which you will apply directly to HTML text elements. By the end, you will be able to adjust text readability and visual style by modifying spacing in your web pages.
intro.usecase: Letter-spacing and word-spacing are essential for creating polished, readable interfaces in real-world applications. Designers use these properties to improve legibility in dense data tables and dashboards, create visual hierarchy in navigation menus, and ensure comfortable reading in long-form content like blog posts or documentation. For example, increasing letter-spacing on uppercase navigation labels or decreasing word-spacing in compact form fields can significantly enhance user experience. These subtle typographic adjustments are what separate amateur-looking interfaces from professionally designed products.

objectives: Apply letter-spacing to adjust the spacing between characters in text elements
Configure word-spacing to control the space between words within paragraphs
Manipulate letter-spacing values using different CSS units (px, em, rem)
Construct CSS rules that combine letter-spacing and word-spacing properties
Update existing text styles by integrating spacing adjustments
Implement responsive spacing changes using relative units
Control text readability by adjusting both character and word spacing
